dialogue.content: こんばんは。今日はよろしくお願いします。時間になったら、また連絡しますね。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for meeting with me today. I’ll reach out again when it’s time.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします！わかりました
dialogue.English: Good evening, thank you! Understood.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。まず最初に、お名前、性別、ご年齢をお伺いできますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening, this is the counselor. To start, may I ask your name, gender, and age?

dialogue.content: こんばんはぴっころです20代女です
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm Piccolo, a woman in my 20s.

dialogue.content: ぴっころさんですね。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Piccolo, is that right? It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: So, what would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 不安な気持ちが止まらない時があるんです
dialogue.English: There are times when I can’t stop feeling anxious.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どういった時に現れるのですか？
dialogue.English: When do these feelings tend to appear?

dialogue.content: なんかやらかしてしまった時です
dialogue.English: It's when I feel like I've messed something up.

dialogue.content: 今日ヘアアイロンの電源切ったよね
dialogue.English: Like, 'Did I turn off my hair iron today?'

dialogue.content: とか
dialogue.English: Things like that.

dialogue.content: ちゃんとコンセント抜いたかなとか
dialogue.English: Or, 'Did I really unplug it?'

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 仕事だと会計の金額間違えなかったかなとか
dialogue.English: At work, it's things like, 'Did I make a mistake with the payment amount?'

dialogue.content: 正しく言えばやらかしてはいないんですけど、なんかやってしまったかも！って心配で不安になるんです
dialogue.English: To be precise, I haven't actually messed up, but I get worried and anxious, thinking 'What if I did something wrong!?'

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 心臓がドキドキしてやばいです
dialogue.English: My heart starts pounding, and it's awful.

dialogue.content: 失敗したらどうしようかと思うと、不安になりますよね
dialogue.English: Thinking about what would happen if you made a mistake must be very anxiety-inducing.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: それがなんかさらに強くなる時があるんです
dialogue.English: And sometimes, that feeling gets even stronger.

dialogue.content: 体調の方は大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling physically?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます体調は大丈夫です！
dialogue.English: Thank you for asking. Physically, I'm fine!

dialogue.content: よかったです。さらに強くなるというのは、どういう時なのですか？
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. When does the feeling get stronger?

dialogue.content: 確認できない時です
dialogue.English: It's when I can't check.

dialogue.content: 例えばコンセント抜いてないかも火事になっちゃう、、、ああ、今日は母がいたから確認してもらお
dialogue.English: For example, 'Maybe I didn't unplug it... it could cause a fire... Oh, but my mom was home today, so I can ask her to check.'

dialogue.content: だったら平気なんです
dialogue.English: In that case, I'm okay.

dialogue.content: ええ(続けてください)
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, please continue.

dialogue.content: けど、家族旅行で誰にも確認してもらえないと不安なまま旅行続けてます
dialogue.English: But, if we're on a family trip and there's no one who can check for me, I just have to continue the trip while feeling anxious.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。そうなると、旅行も100％楽しめなくて、つらくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, it’s hard to fully enjoy the trip, and that can be tough.

dialogue.content: そうなんですずっと気がかりなままで
dialogue.English: Exactly. It's on my mind the whole time.

dialogue.content: 仕事の内容も3回くらい確認してしまいます
dialogue.English: I also end up checking my work about three times.

dialogue.content: お話いただきありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは常に神経使ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That must be very mentally draining, being on edge all the time.

dialogue.content: めっちゃ疲れます
dialogue.English: It’s really exhausting.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: では、どうしたら不安な気持ちが少しでも解消できるか、一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: Okay, then let's think together about what we can do to help ease those anxious feelings, even just a little.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そういった不安は、いつから始まりましたか？
dialogue.English: When did this kind of anxiety start?

dialogue.content: うーん大人になってからかなぁ
dialogue.English: Hmm, probably after I became an adult.

dialogue.content: 学生時代にはなかったように思います
dialogue.English: I don’t think I had it when I was a student.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 大人からとなると、仕事に就いてからが連想されるのですが、何かきっかけとかはありましたか？
dialogue.English: If it started in adulthood, that makes me think of after you began working. Was there any particular trigger?

dialogue.content: きっかけは別にわからないですけど、、、大人と仕事と言われると責任が伴うようになってからかな
dialogue.English: I don't know about a specific trigger, but... when you mention adulthood and work, maybe it's since I started having responsibilities.

dialogue.content: あーそうかも
dialogue.English: Ah, that might be it.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。ご職業は、会計処理のお話をされていたので、経理ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Since you mentioned accounting tasks, are you in accounting?

dialogue.content: いえ、病院の会計事務です
dialogue.English: No, I do billing at a hospital.

dialogue.content: 病院でのお仕事だったのですね。
dialogue.English: So you work at a hospital.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのお仕事では、どういったことを求められるのですか？
dialogue.English: What is expected of you in that job?

dialogue.content: スピーディーにミスなく
dialogue.English: To be quick and accurate.

dialogue.content: はい(続けてください)
dialogue.English: I see, please continue.

dialogue.content: 患者様を労ってですかね
dialogue.English: And to be considerate of the patients, I suppose.

dialogue.content: なるほど。確かに大切そうです。
dialogue.English: I see. That certainly sounds important.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 特に病院ですと、ミスは許されないような印象もあります。
dialogue.English: Especially at a hospital, there's an impression that mistakes are not tolerated.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 病人にミスして何回もご足労かけるわけにはいかないし
dialogue.English: I can't make mistakes that would inconvenience sick patients multiple times.

dialogue.content: 信用問題もあるし
dialogue.English: And there’s also the issue of trust.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: そのくらい、ぴっころさんは責任感のあるお仕事をされているのですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you have a job with a great deal of responsibility, Piccolo.

dialogue.content: そう言っていただけるとなんかすごい感じがして嬉しいですね
dialogue.English: When you put it that way, it makes it sound like something amazing. That makes me happy.

dialogue.content: あーけど別に間違える同僚もいるんですけど
dialogue.English: Ah, but I do have colleagues who make mistakes.

dialogue.content: 本当にそう思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I truly think so.

dialogue.content: なんか自分はしたくないと思っちゃうんですよね
dialogue.English: I just really don’t want to be the one to make mistakes.

dialogue.content: ええ(続けてください)
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, please continue.

dialogue.content: プライド高いのかしら
dialogue.English: Maybe I have too much pride.

dialogue.content: 私には、誇りをもって仕事をされているんだなと感じましたよ。
dialogue.English: To me, it sounds like you take pride in your work.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 職場の雰囲気はどうですか？
dialogue.English: What's the atmosphere like at your workplace?

dialogue.content: 雰囲気は悪くないです
dialogue.English: The atmosphere isn’t bad.

dialogue.content: たぶん本当はミスっても周りも協力してくれそうなくらいには
dialogue.English: I think if I did make a mistake, my colleagues would probably be cooperative enough to help.

dialogue.content: それは素晴らしいです。では互いにフォローしあえるコミュニケーションはできるということですね。
dialogue.English: That’s wonderful. So it sounds like there’s communication where you can support each other.

dialogue.content: そうですね、はい
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: いいことです。
dialogue.English: That's a good thing.

dialogue.content: この不安感は今の職場の前からあるんですよね😅
dialogue.English: This anxiety is something I've had since before my current job, actually.

dialogue.content: だから職場よりはもう自分の性質？なのかなって
dialogue.English: So I think it's less about my workplace and more about my own nature, maybe?

dialogue.content: そうなのですか？お話しできる範囲で大丈夫ですので、お伺いできますか？
dialogue.English: Is that so? Could you tell me more, only as much as you're comfortable sharing?

dialogue.content: さっき大人と仕事って問いかけられた時
dialogue.English: A moment ago, when you asked about adulthood and work...

dialogue.content: ええ(続けてください)
dialogue.English: Yes, please go on.

dialogue.content: 責任かなって思ったんですけど
dialogue.English: I thought it might be about responsibility,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: うん、失敗したくないって思ってます
dialogue.English: Yeah, I just don’t want to fail.

dialogue.content: 責任ではなくて、失敗したくない思いが強いのですね。
dialogue.English: So it's not so much about responsibility, but a strong desire not to fail.

dialogue.content: それに自分だけで責任が取れることは不安にならない気がします
dialogue.English: Also, I don't think I feel anxious about things where I can take full responsibility by myself.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。言える範囲で結構ですので、もう少しだけ詳しく教えていただけませんか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you explain that a little more, just what you feel comfortable sharing?

dialogue.content: たとえば車の運転で事故るかもと思っても自分だけの責任で保険にも入ってるしよっぽどの事故起こさなければ平気って
dialogue.English: For example, when I'm driving, I might worry about getting into an accident, but it's my own responsibility, I have insurance, and unless I cause a major accident, it'll be okay.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 安全運転してるしそこまでの大事故は起こさないだろうと
dialogue.English: I drive safely, so I probably wouldn’t cause that kind of major accident.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 仕事でも自分だけが謝罪すればいいミスは平気です
dialogue.English: Even at work, if it's a mistake that only requires me to apologize, I'm fine with it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ただ周りに迷惑かけそうな事態まで発展しそうと思うとダメかも
dialogue.English: But if I think it could develop into a situation that inconveniences others, I can’t handle it.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。失敗することで、周りに影響してしまうことが、不安だったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So what you were anxious about was how your failure might affect those around you.

dialogue.content: そうだったみたいです
dialogue.English: That seems to be the case.

dialogue.content: その気持ち、わかります。
dialogue.English: I understand that feeling.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: Do you?

dialogue.content: みんなも不安になるのかしら
dialogue.English: I wonder if everyone feels anxious like this.

dialogue.content: お話いただきありがとうございます。ここまでお話しされて見てどう感じましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. How do you feel, having talked about this so far?

dialogue.content: 失敗したくないプライドの高さと
dialogue.English: My strong pride about not wanting to fail, and—

dialogue.content: 私も不安になりますよ。
dialogue.English: I get anxious too.

dialogue.content: 周りに迷惑かけたくない感じはあってると思います
dialogue.English: and the feeling of not wanting to bother others, I think that's right.

dialogue.content: ええ(続けてください)
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, please continue.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: つまりそういう場面を特に注意していけば今までよりはマシになるのかな
dialogue.English: So, does that mean if I'm especially careful in those situations, it might get better than it has been?

dialogue.content: そうだと思います。あとこれは、カウンセラーとしてのお節介ですが、
dialogue.English: I think so. And this might be me overstepping as a counselor, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 時間に余裕を持つことを心掛けるのも大切だと思ってます。
dialogue.English: I think it’s also important to try to give yourself extra time.

dialogue.content: どういうことですか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean?

dialogue.content: 例えば、旅行の出発には、思ってた予定のさらに30分前に出る。
dialogue.English: For example, when leaving for a trip, leave 30 minutes earlier than you originally planned.

dialogue.content: ふんふん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: もしくは、前日に、持ち物リストを作っておくと、朝の準備もスムーズに、余裕をもって出かけられると思います
dialogue.English: Or, if you make a packing list the day before, your morning preparations will go smoothly, and you'll be able to leave with time to spare.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: とはいえ失敗を完全に0にするというのも、私たちは人間なので不可能ということを念頭に置いて、
dialogue.English: That said, it's also important to keep in mind that since we're human, it's impossible to eliminate mistakes completely.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 仮に何か心配ごとが起きたら、メモを残しておいて、リストに追加しておくなど
dialogue.English: If a worry does come up, you could make a note of it and add it to a list.

dialogue.content: やらかしてしまうのはある程度パターンがあり限られているものなので、積み重ねていけばきっと解消していくと思いますよ
dialogue.English: The kinds of things we worry about messing up tend to follow a pattern and are limited, so if you keep track of them, I believe you can resolve them over time.

dialogue.content: あーなるほど不安リストを作ってみるということですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. So you mean I should try making an anxiety list.

dialogue.content: それを気をつけてみると
dialogue.English: And then be mindful of those.

dialogue.content: そうです。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: なるほどわかりました
dialogue.English: Got it.

dialogue.content: 今のお話を聴いてみて、率直にぴっころさんはどう感じましたか？
dialogue.English: After hearing these ideas, how do you honestly feel about them, Pikkoro?

dialogue.content: 旅行リストはもともと作る派なので変わらないかなと思います不安リストはやってみようかなと思います
dialogue.English: I already make lists for trips, so I don't think that will change much. But I think I'll try making an anxiety list.

dialogue.content: たしかに仕事とかでも覚えたら普通にこなしてることありますもんね
dialogue.English: It's true that with work and other things, once I learn how to do something, I can do it without any issues.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。さすがですね。日記みたいに、不安リストを振り返りするのもおすすめですよ。
dialogue.English: I see. That's very organized of you. I also recommend reviewing your anxiety list, like a diary.

dialogue.content: 振り返り
dialogue.English: Reviewing it?

dialogue.content: 今日は気をつけられたなーとか？
dialogue.English: Like, 'I was careful about this today'?

dialogue.content: 頭だけでなく、紙に書きだすことで、より明確化することもあるので
dialogue.English: By writing it down on paper, not just keeping it in your head, things can become clearer.

dialogue.content: ああそういうこと
dialogue.English: Ah, that's what you mean.

dialogue.content: わかりました！
dialogue.English: Got it!

dialogue.content: 日記みたいに、今日不安を感じたこととか、失敗したことに対する対策を書き出すとかです
dialogue.English: Like a diary, you could write down what you felt anxious about today, or what countermeasures you took for a mistake.

dialogue.content: なるほどー
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: やってみます
dialogue.English: I’ll give it a try.

dialogue.content: リスト化に関しては、事が起きた時は冷静に物事を判断できないので、冷静な時にあらかじめリスト化しておくという狙いもあります
dialogue.English: Regarding the list, another purpose is that when something happens, it's hard to judge things calmly. So the idea is to make the list beforehand when you are calm.

dialogue.content: ぜひ試してみてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please do give it a try.

dialogue.content: はーい🙋‍♀️
dialogue.English: Okay! 🙋‍♀️

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間なので終了しようと思うのですが、全体を通していかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up, so I'd like to start wrapping up. How do you feel about our session today?

dialogue.content: とりあえず対策できそうかなと思えてきたので前向きにやってみます
dialogue.English: I feel like I've found a strategy I can try, so I'm going to approach this with a positive attitude.

dialogue.content: なるべくドキドキな不安なく穏やかに生活したい笑
dialogue.English: I want to live as calmly as possible without that heart-pounding anxiety, haha.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: そうですよね。穏やかな生活ができることを、心から願っています。
dialogue.English: Absolutely. I sincerely hope you can have a calm, peaceful life.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました😊
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. 😊
